title: Actual Nemotron inference and restored launcher generation on N35
question: Does one Integrated page invoke actual Nemotron inference and restore the owned launcher generation?
method: Run one new physical page through the admitted Integrated profile using matching archived source. Compare service and native receipt observations before and after.
conclusion: One previously unseen page made two completed Nemotron requests. All five native operations fulfilled and the launcher returned to the same generation and sleep state.
